gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-chakm: Relaxed and inviting, Delius Unicase moves with the steadiness of a technical pen, no tapering at any stroke end. Noto Sans Chakma then reads approachably, its s and c uncrowded.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-cham: Strokes that never swell or thin give Delius Unicase its unmistakable handwritten feel. And Noto Sans Cham adds tall, rounded lowercase forms and open c shapes, so the two sit comfortably together.

gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-chora: Chunky, friendly handwriting with lines that hold their thickness throughout, paired with curves that stop short instead of closing. Shrink Delius Unicase and its rope-ladder spacing loses its charm.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-copti: Stitched-thread simplicity, relaxed and inviting, runs through Delius Unicase with its pronounced x-height. But Noto Sans Coptic lets the middle zone dominate each line, and its s and c stay uncrowded.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-cunei: Delius Unicase looks like letters bent from a single length of wire, relaxed and inviting. Noto Sans Cuneiform has an e that opens up and swollen lowercase, so longer text feels plump and clean.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-deser: Delius Unicase is monoline all the way through, relaxed and inviting, with no tapering where strokes meet or end. Its friendliness is the pair's greatest asset beside Noto Sans Deseret.
